systems.system: Hub for AI and Disability Inclusion (HAIDI)

GHA.note: HAIDI is a disability data and AI research hub, not a government rule or programme making information or digital services accessible.

KEN.note: Names Kenya only for Kenyan Sign Language data gaps and the launch venue; no government accessibility rule or programme.

RWA.note: Names Rwanda only as a scoping-study country and for missing Kinyarwanda speech-impairment data; no government accessibility rule or programme.
